Retry policy

The retry delay is 500 milliseconds. Retry only idempotent requests after transient errors.

Warning: Never retry a payment without an idempotency key.

Client setup

const client = new ExampleClient({ timeout: 15000 });
await client.connect();
console.log("connected");

timeout 15000
retries 2
